response.justification: Bogdan Szabo demonstrates strong full-stack and infrastructure engineering skills with exposure to AI-agent infrastructure and Model Context Protocol (MCP) work, aligning well with the technical requirements. However, his direct experience with production-grade GenAI solutions and RAG architectures is less explicitly detailed, and his leadership in customer-facing technical roles is not prominently highlighted.
strengths: Extensive experience (10+ years) in full-stack development with TypeScript and Node.js, relevant to the role's language requirements.
Recent contributions to AI-agent infrastructure and MCP code generators at re:cinq, showing alignment with GenAI and multi-agent systems.
Strong background in designing scalable systems and developer tooling, with experience in cloud platforms (AWS) and data pipelines.
concerns: Lacks explicit mention of 8+ years building production-grade AI solutions, a core requirement for the role.
Experience with vector databases and RAG architectures is not clearly documented in the resume.
Customer-facing technical leadership and stakeholder management experience is not prominently highlighted.
